headline: California lets prosecutor fine businesses for human chatbot claims
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California gives a public prosecutor the power to penalize large private businesses up to $10,000 for representing a customer service chatbot as human. Passed.

105 measures in 27 states would require a company to file reports with a government body, or hand them over on demand.

28 measures in 11 jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is coming for the jobs.

2,248 measures tracked. 756 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
